surface: installed Tauri WKWebView with actual PWDT Python 3.12.7
scope: idle managed service loss, blocked save, draft retention, explicit restart and healthy follow-up
native_actions: PWDT created and solved a four-node six-member truss, then translated the apex from 1.25 m to 1.50 m without saving
Installer GUI Check services showed four running managed services; independent API read found fourteen terminal jobs and no active job
Installer GUI Stop all stopped the frontend, Orchestra and two Rust agents; the loaded Workbench remained usable
PWDT refresh observed no health; model/save was blocked with Control plane is offline, retaining selection, metadata and working geometry
Installer GUI Start local restored all four services without changing the database
PWDT read-only refresh retained the original model/version selection; explicit save committed one new version and a real Rust-agent solve completed
limits: The offline save was rejected before transport. This is not native post-commit response-loss or interrupted-write qualification.
The WebView stayed open during the outage. Durable recovery of automatic GUI request keys after WebView closure remains open.
The three new request-identity/authority races were reproduced in source unit tests, not by mutating an installed WebView transport.
Catalog/history response failures were exercised in Chromium HTTP mocks, separately from native service controls.
Only the bounded linear 3D truss and local SQLite service lifecycle were exercised, not large meshes or other solver families.
macOS packages are development ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized distribution artifacts. Windows work is deferred, not qualified.
